games.name: Pigeon's Number Line
games.note: Honest placing with six help levels. Many numerals printed at full help; near goes are a coin toss; the reason is text and an emoji.

games.name: Parrot's See-saw
games.note: Stone goes model equality well. Card goes leave a 50% tell; the see-saw stays flat on false sums.

games.name: Lizard's Bundles
games.note: The model is right, but tying ten sticks is only required on the first go, and a wrong attempt is wiped. The weakest 24.

games.name: Swamp Hen's Reed Rows
games.note: Counting rows is honest. Share and turn are watched, not done. Played by script only.

games.name: Robin's Berry Basket
games.note: Give goes are good. On card goes the answer is nearly always the third card, so counting is never needed. Under the bar (Maths 2).

games.name: Kingfisher's Dairy
games.note: Not built yet, so not scored. Card S20 reviews it with the same method once it is live.

games.name: Weka's Stepping Stones
games.note: Still the steadiest. Support fell only because this review asked for more.

moves.why: No code change. This review wanted a demo for each new kind of go.
Why-lines and look-together (R5).

games.name: Quick looks
games.note: Every answer saved now. A wrong answer still shows the answer at once with no second try; voice off by default.

moves.why: Every answer saved; teacher sees stage (R3, R7).

games.name: Tūī's Ten Tree
games.note: Fading fixed and take-away added. Full ten-frames still last about 8 days for a child who gets it all right.

moves.why: No code change. Same stricter test as Weka.
The fading bug is fixed (R1). Level 4 is still a floor on steps 2 to 4.
Take-away and a longer ladder (R8, R9).
Why-lines and look-together (R5).

games.name: Pipi's Hidden Shells
games.note: Help per fact and why-lines are big gains. No "Hear it again"; replays move the level.

moves.why: Help per fact that comes back after weak goes (R6).
Why-lines and look-together for every wrong shell (R5).
Grid and alerts are new, but per-fact rows already existed.

games.name: Penguin Pairs (Kororā)
games.note: Biggest real gain on Maths and Feedback. New halves still share themselves; level 5 unknown to the teacher view.

moves.why: Times-itself wrong answers gone and a real pile, but tap-all now read as one loophole.
Help per fact (R6).
Level 5 added, but the top is still short.
Why-lines, look-together and a pair-off hint (R5, R9).

games.name: Kiwi's Beanstalk
games.note: Much clearer, but the sum still moves by the calendar. The only older game under the bar (Progression 2).

moves.why: No repeated numbers, target on screen, bridge to 100 (R4).
Dots per child that fade and come back.
Why-line, frame and look-together replace the wobble (R5).
In the grid now, but per-fact rows existed and 100 and 1000 still share one key.

games.name: Hop's Glow-worm Pond
games.note: Largest rise. Still no "Hear it again", replays move the step, and the teacher view knows only steps 10, 5 and 2.

moves.why: The endings tell is gone, and tap-all is now read as one loophole.
Help per hop that comes back (R6).
Counting back, steps of 3 and 4, and to 200 (R8).
Why-lines and look-together (R5).
Grid and alerts are new; per-fact rows existed.

new.issue: Redo after look-together can be copied
new.detail: After the look-together shows the answer, all choices come back in the same order and the child taps the stone they just saw. It proves they watched, not that they know.

new.issue: Five-part go: pebbles now need a Check tap
new.detail: The drag-and-Check pebble step adds one more action to a go that already has four phases. Weaker juniors can run out of patience before the bond step.

new.issue: Split and bond steps still only say 'Try again'
new.detail: The new mistake why-lines were built for the answer step only. Misses in split and bond get no reason.

new.issue: A lucky fast guess counts as quick
new.detail: Quick days count speed for any right answer, so guessing can move help down the ladder.

new.issue: Level-up praise is about ability
new.detail: 'You are so good at this!' praises the child, not the effort or the strategy.

new.issue: Redo after look-together can be copied
new.detail: The look-together says and shows the answer, then the redo shows the same four nests reversed. The child can tap the one they were just told.

new.issue: Ten-frames stay on for about 8 days for a perfect child
new.detail: Floor of level 4 on steps 2 to 4 was kept on purpose. A child who is right every day still sees full pictures for over a week, which slows fading.

new.issue: Dead code: picture thinning after wrong taps
new.detail: pictureFor still works out thinner nests but nothing uses it. Misleading for the next person.

new.issue: Praise for a redo is the same as for first try
new.detail: After a look-together the redo earns 'Well done!' even though the answer was just shown.

new.issue: Start step and 'secure' only use the add facts
new.detail: The take-away facts have their own keys now but startFor uses only the add keys, so a child weak at taking away is not noticed.

new.issue: Reading aloud is off by default
new.detail: The saved setting is false until switched on, so pre-readers get no voice unless a grown-up turns it on, even though all the clips now exist.

new.issue: No second try at the same picture
new.detail: After a wrong answer the child is shown the answer and moves on. They never try the same picture again.

new.issue: Slow answer (over 4 seconds) counts as struggling
new.detail: A careful child who thinks for over 4 s gets help pictures and the helped answer does not count towards the stage.

new.issue: Guided mode never grows the garden
new.detail: Because answers with the picture kept on are practice only, a child on this setting can never finish a stage. The summary tells them, but the setting is for children who most need it.

new.issue: Stage placement uses only 2 pictures per test
new.detail: One slip or one lucky guess moves the start by several stages.

new.issue: Picture label says '1 counters'
new.detail: The spoken picture description gets the plural wrong for one counter, for screen readers.

new.issue: Teacher grid does not know Hop steps 3, 4 and 200
new.detail: Config lists steps 10, 5, 2 only and top 2, so a child on step 3, 4 or 200 shows wrongly and the new keys are not in any grid column.

new.issue: Teacher grid does not know Penguin Pairs level 5
new.detail: Config stops at level 4 with top 4, so level 5 has no name and may be flagged 'same level too long'. Near doubles are not in the hardest list.

new.issue: Bonds to 20 are invisible to the teacher grid
new.detail: bond20: keys are in no column; the about text still says the next beanstalk makes 100.

new.issue: Missing-leaf go arrives with no demonstration and the 10th is forced
new.detail: The leaf is pre-picked with no first-time tip; on the last go only two leaves remain so it is a 50-50.

new.issue: Redo after look-together can be copied
new.detail: The answer or sum was just shown, so Now you try can be done by copying. In Pipi and Hop the choices are reshuffled, in Beanstalk the frame already holds the partner.

new.issue: Look-together is long and can only be skipped after 3 seconds
new.detail: Runs up to 12 seconds; counting to 9 or 200 in Hop is slow and a child who already sees the answer must wait.

new.issue: Full help can last too long on each fact
new.detail: A new fact stays on full help until box 2 plus 2 quick days, and every new level or step starts at full help again, so a keen child may not be stretched.

new.issue: New question kinds arrive with no demonstration
new.detail: Near doubles at level 5 and the new fair pile start with no first-time tip.

new.issue: Counting back and from-3 starts arrive with no demonstration
new.detail: Back hops and non-multiple starts appear on gold days with no tip.

new.issue: More sums stretch the 30-day arc
new.detail: Four sums on one calendar mean each gets few days, and the sum is chosen by days not by what the child knows.

new.issue: Pipi finish screen praises ability and never says what is next
new.detail: Same 'Well done' and 'You are so good at this' whatever the accuracy; no signpost at level 3.

new.issue: Replays the same day can move the level or step
new.detail: Pipi, Penguin Pairs and Hop recompute the level on every finish, so replaying after a bad round can drop or lift it.
